post.text:
Our design team at @bunsenstudio is compiling a list of our favorite Figma plugins.

What are we missing?

• Logo layout
• Remove BG
• Assign Color Value to Text
• Chromatic Figma
• Batch Styler
• Font Swap
• Loom Embed
• Above the Fold
• Unsplash
• Use Contrast
• Gifmock
• Pitchdeck Presentation Studio
• Lorem Ipsum
• Noise & Texture
• PasteSVG
• Deck
• Insert Big Image
• TinyImage Compressor

Gotta check this one out next. Turn SVGs into 3D renders. By @glyfspace.

https://t.co/cqQSFdpjcS
